_note: Oldest-end sweep batch 86: 15-17 June 2026. Model claude-opus-5, prompt v1.

mentions.claim_text: He notes that happened today and that there were two big earthquakes in one day, asks whether any temples fell, and says the Lord said he is going to shake down thousand-year old temples, then notes another meteor which was on the 14th though he does not know why it is only now coming out.
mentions.quote: he's going to shake down thousand-y old temples
mentions.falsify_miss: Earthquakes that damage no temples. He asks the question himself, whether any temples fell, and the answer given is that they have not seen it, which is a fulfilment claim made before the fulfilment is confirmed.

mentions.claim_text: He prays to run the race strong, to expose the deep state over this nation, and for Trump to have a backbone like a crowbar and not sway knowing this is the finale, says he does not want to let this go yet because he is seeing on the other side of 2026, and that he sees January of 2027 highlighted.
mentions.quote: I'm seeing on the other side of 2026. January of 2027
mentions.falsify_miss: None. Highlighted names no event at all, so any January would satisfy it and no January could fail it.

mentions.claim_text: He says he does not always know which part he is seeing and which he is hearing but knows there is an escalation, that he saw Israel acting alone, that when this happened he saw the hook in the jaw and saw Russia, that he saw Turkey rise up with Syria and a wounded brother coming in the days ahead with Syria, that Turkey came to the aid of Syria, and that he saw Damascus becoming a ruinous heap.
mentions.quote: I saw Damascus becoming a ruinous heap
mentions.falsify_match: Turkey and Russia entering a Syrian war alongside Israeli action, with Damascus destroyed.
mentions.falsify_miss: None on a date. Damascus becoming a ruinous heap is a direct quotation of Isaiah 17, so the wording is scriptural rather than descriptive, and it has been claimed as imminent by many people for a long time.

mentions.claim_text: He reacts to a clip about indignities inflicted on the country, says he cannot listen to him any more and the man is bad, that this is basically him throwing his hat in the ring and telling you he is running for president in 2028, and that they will now hear that snake start to slither as it gets close to his time.
mentions.falsify_match: The man announcing a 2028 presidential run.
mentions.falsify_miss: He does not run. This is read off a speech rather than received, and he says so: it is his inference about what the man is signalling.

mentions.claim_text: He says he told them to watch this man concerning 2028, that even before Trump won he said he sees Gavin and saw Gavin's face and they have the videos to prove it, that Gavin will run, and that the person he saw run beside Gavin was Michelle Obama, whom he saw standing there.
mentions.quote: I'm telling you, Gavin will run
mentions.falsify_match: Newsom running in 2028, with Michelle Obama on the ticket or beside him.
mentions.falsify_miss: Neither runs. He offers the receipts himself, saying they have the videos to prove he said it before the 2024 result, which makes the priority claim checkable inside this corpus. The pairing with Michelle Obama is the part that would distinguish it from an obvious guess.

mentions.claim_text: He describes seeing something like Indiana Jones with arrows coming out and that he saw certain politicians who had a lot of money in it, then turns to a report that broke overnight that the National Security Agency intercepted conversations of President Zelensky.
mentions.quote: I saw certain politicians that had a bunch of money in it
mentions.falsify_match: Named politicians shown to have profited from the aid.
mentions.falsify_miss: None named. Certain politicians with a bunch of money identifies nobody, so no report could confirm or refute it.

mentions.claim_text: He plays a report citing FBI documents about China possibly conspiring with Joe Biden and the Democrats over the 2020 election and now possibly Ukraine, with two investigations underway, and responds that it is pretty accurate but asks where the rest of it is, saying two hundred million was reported while he saw billions and saw the number.
mentions.quote: 200 million. Where's the rest of it? I saw billions
mentions.falsify_match: Sums in the billions established by the investigations.
mentions.falsify_miss: The figure stays at hundreds of millions. He raises the mismatch himself, that he saw billions and the report says two hundred million, and resolves it by assuming the rest is still to come rather than that the figure was wrong. That is the move worth recording.

mentions.claim_text: He declares in prayer that he sees the 14 and repeats it, calls come and says it is time to come and they will be blessed, and commands all demonic hindrances to bow the knee, get out of the way and open the door.
mentions.falsify_match: Something identifiable attaching to the number 14.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. A bare number with no month, no year and no event attached to it.

mentions.claim_text: He says they are going to pray over the Fourth of July, that he sees the Sooners again and sees South Korea, and describes a big cauldron like a dip with water in it, saying he sees the crypto.
mentions.quote: I see the Sooners again. I see South Korea
mentions.falsify_match: Korean crypto action around that date.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. The cauldron image is not interpreted and no action, threshold or direction is named.

mentions.claim_text: He recites the passage about the Lord passing before him and proclaiming himself merciful and gracious, long-suffering and abounding in goodness and truth, says his mercy is abounding and his truth is marching on, and then says that as he sees the Fourth of July he can see it and can see South Korea.
mentions.quote: As I see the Fourth of July, I can see it
mentions.falsify_match: Something connecting South Korea to the Fourth of July.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. I can see it names nothing that was seen, and the passage is scripture and hymn with the impression appended.

mentions.claim_text: He says praise the Lord tonight and that his goodness and mercy passed by him, recites lines from the Battle Hymn of the Republic while noting he does not know all the words, calls it amazing, and says he could see the Fourth of July.
mentions.quote: I could see the Fourth of July
mentions.falsify_match: n/a: worship with nothing stated about the day.

mentions.claim_text: He says to go back to January and what the Lord said, that he hates quoting governments but has to for some of this, that he saw somebody secret within Russia and somebody in France and will say no more than that because it is easier today, and that they specifically had an assignment to eliminate the president from a building fifty yards away, and that he saw a fifty calibre.
mentions.quote: an assignment to uh eliminate our president on a building that was 50 yards
mentions.falsify_match: A foiled long-range attempt on the president traced to Russian and French involvement.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such attempt. The specifics here are unusually hard, two countries, a distance and a calibre, which makes it scoreable if anything ever emerges. He again withholds part of it, saying that is all he will say.
